## Description

<!-- What must be built or fixed, and why. Two to four sentences an implementer can act on. -->

### Context

<!-- The verified current state: classes, methods, endpoints and files involved, with their paths.
State what you checked, not what you assume. -->

### Scope

<!-- What this issue covers. This is what the implementer is allowed to change. -->

### Out of scope

<!-- What must not change, and what is deferred to another issue. Delete this section when nothing
is excluded. -->

### Approach

<!-- The chosen design. When alternatives were weighed, name them and say why they were rejected. -->

### Implementation notes

<!-- Conventions to follow, constraints, gotchas, migration versions, files to create or modify. -->

### Testing

<!-- Which tests to add or update, and at which level: unit, Mockito, or Spring slice. -->

### Dependencies

<!-- Other issues, pull requests, or external prerequisites. Delete this section when there are none. -->

## Acceptance Criteria

<!-- One testable statement per bullet. The item is done when every box can be ticked. -->
